original_test_intent: Validate the SMBIOS Type 38 Interface Type enumeration against the platform's intended BMC host interface, including Unknown/reserved handling, record validity and persistence after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 38 with version/length, decode the raw enum, compare with approved KCS/SMIC/BT/SSIF expectations, optionally corroborate read-only IPMI driver/BMC transport and Type 42 context, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user provides the expected host interface and approves reboot; SMBIOS and optional IPMI corroboration are read-only software actions.
required_inputs: Expected BMC host interface for the platform
Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 length/enum and multiple-record policy
Validated raw decoder and optional read-only IPMI/driver evidence
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/BMC/IPMI queries; do not change transport settings or load/unload drivers merely to match the field.
Preserve raw enum and length; distinguish 00h Unknown and reserved encodings from valid transports.
Use Type 42 or driver evidence only as corroboration, not a silent replacement for Type 38.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on management loss or contradiction and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type 38 record/length and raw enum, compare the approved transport, collect optional read-only corroboration and compare pre/post reboot.
Report absent, duplicate, unknown, reserved or contradictory evidence without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected transport, duplicate/Type 42 policy and reboot plan.
Resolve Type 38 versus platform/BMC evidence discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw enum, record length, duplicate handling or actual platform transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 38; report handle/length, raw/normalized interface enum, expected transport, optional driver/BMC/Type 42 corroboration and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Interface Type scope, Type 38 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no BMC/interface configuration change is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: RAW ENUM AND TRANSPORT-CORRELATED INTERFACE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Version/length-validate Type 38, decode raw Interface Type, compare with approved platform transport, corroborate without modifying state, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 38 IPMI Device Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and optional IPMI driver/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 Interface Type definitions and platform BMC host-interface design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum, record validation and non-substitutive transport corroboration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects reserved/Unknown encodings, truncated/duplicate records and mismatch with the actual platform design missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved interface baseline and Type 42/corroboration policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS driver availability may not prove firmware transport identity; Type 42 describes broader management interfaces and is not identical to Type 38.

project_override_considerations: Projects may legitimately use different host interfaces or Type 42 alongside Type 38, but must specify the expected relationship; missing optional corroboration does not change the Type 38 enum itself.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/BMC interface and Type 38/Type 42 policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 38 with handle/length/version and raw/decoded enum
Optional read-only IPMI driver/BMC/Type 42 evidence clearly labeled as corroboration
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot record/transport diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Interface Type is a defined Type 38 field; platform transport and coexistence details are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Record, enum and corroboration checks are fully automatable after inputs; missing tools or baseline affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum/length, reserved handling and actual transport correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains BMC safety and Type 42 distinction while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates expected baseline/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from execution capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a friendly transport label from passing when sourced from a truncated/reserved record or inconsistent with the platform BMC interface.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 38 parsing and read-only transport correlation are deterministic software tasks; project confirmation does not make the core manual.
